enabled.description: Whether a sink is configured and submitting.

ca_bundle_path.description: PEM bundle the receiver's certificate is verified against. Required; there is no unverified mode.

server_name.description: Name expected in the receiver's certificate. Defaults to the host part of the address.

client_cert_path.description: Client certificate for mutual TLS. Both this and the key must be set, or neither.

max_frame_bytes.description: Largest message this receiver accepts. A record that does not fit is truncated at a field boundary and marked, never cut mid-record. Zero means no limit.

facility.description: Syslog facility. Defaults to 13, log audit.

connected.description: Read-only. Whether a session is currently established.

submitted.description: Read-only. Records written to the socket since this sink was configured. Not a delivery count, the protocol carries no acknowledgement.

truncated.description: Read-only. Records that did not fit the receiver's cap and were sent shortened.

write_errors.description: Read-only. Submissions that failed, each of which stops the cursor from advancing.

last_error.description: Read-only. The most recent transport error, empty when the last attempt succeeded.
